propertyTypes.Apartment: Multi-story residential units in a building, typically with shared amenities like gym, pool, and security.
propertyTypes.Villa: Independent houses with private gardens, offering more privacy and space.
propertyTypes.Penthouse: Luxury apartments on the top floor of a building, often with premium features and views.
propertyTypes.Studio: Compact single-room apartments ideal for individuals or couples.
propertyTypes.House: Independent residential buildings, perfect for families needing more space.

amenities.Gym: Fitness centers with modern equipment for residents.
amenities.Power Backup: Backup power supply for uninterrupted electricity.

priceRanges.budget: Properties under ₹50 lakhs - typically studios and 1BHK apartments
priceRanges.mid-range: Properties between ₹50 lakhs to ₹1.5 crores - 2-3BHK apartments and smaller villas
priceRanges.premium: Properties between ₹1.5 crores to ₹5 crores - 3-4BHK apartments and villas
priceRanges.luxury: Properties above ₹5 crores - penthouses and large independent houses

locationInfo.Downtown: Prime commercial and residential areas with excellent connectivity, shopping, and entertainment options.
locationInfo.Suburban: Peaceful residential neighborhoods away from city center, ideal for families.
locationInfo.Uptown: Luxury residential areas with premium amenities and high-end properties.
locationInfo.Midtown: Well-connected mid-range areas with good infrastructure and accessibility.

emiInfo.explanation: EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) is calculated based on loan amount, interest rate, and tenure. Typically, banks offer 80% loan-to-value ratio.

commonQuestions.payment: We offer flexible payment plans including construction-linked, possession-linked, and down payment options. EMI options available with major banks.
commonQuestions.documents: Required documents include ID proof, address proof, income documents, and property-related papers. Our team will guide you through the process.
commonQuestions.possession: Possession timelines vary by project. Ready-to-move properties are available immediately, while under-construction properties have specific timelines.
commonQuestions.legal: All properties are legally verified with clear titles. We provide all necessary legal documents and certifications.
